gloss: after the fact; ex post facto; post-

definitions.gloss: after the fact; after the event; post-
definitions.explanation: Referring to actions, measures, or reports that come after a main event or situation has occurred.

examples.japanese: {事後|じご}{報告|ほうこく}でも{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: A report after the fact is also acceptable.

examples.japanese: {事後|じご}に{承認|しょうにん}を{得|え}た。
examples.english: We obtained approval after the fact.

examples.japanese: {事後|じご}{対応|たいおう}では{遅|おそ}すぎる。
examples.english: Responding after the fact is too late.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{事|じ} (matter, event) + {後|ご} (after)
Literally: "after the matter" → "after the fact"

GRAMMAR:
Can function as:
・Adverb: {事後|じご}に〜 (after the fact ~)
・Noun modifier: {事後|じご}の〜 (post- ~, ex post facto ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{事後|じご}{報告|ほうこく} - post-event report
・{事後|じご}{承認|しょうにん} - retroactive approval
・{事後|じご}{対応|たいおう} - post-incident response
・{事後|じご}{処理|しょり} - post-processing, aftermath handling
・{事後|じご}{評価|ひょうか} - post-evaluation

ANTONYM:
・{事前|じぜん} - beforehand, in advance

LEGAL TERM:
{事後法|じごほう} - ex post facto law (retroactive law)
